personalizationRules: Every node MUST include syllabusBlockId set to exactly one block id from the catalog.
Personalization is STRUCTURAL: vary which blocks appear, how many nodes each block gets, difficulty, and order — NOT just rewording titles.
block_05a and block_05b are alternative emphasis tracks. Most pathways should prioritize ONE of them (3+ nodes). Only include both fully for profiles explicitly wanting breadth.
prereq_1 Very uncertain OR bloom_remember shows no prior AI courses: assign 3+ nodes to block_01 at beginner difficulty before block_02.
prereq_1 Very confident OR bloom_remember lists ML/neural networks/gradient descent: assign at most 1 compressible node to block_01, then start block_02 or higher.
goals mentioning business, organization, strategy, transformation, workplace: prioritize block_05a (3+ nodes) over block_05b.
goals mentioning research, technical, RAG, fine-tuning, workflows, academic: prioritize block_05b (3+ nodes) over block_05a.
goals mentioning ethics, responsible AI, bias, societal impact: assign 3+ nodes to block_06 with intermediate difficulty.
bloom_remember mentions ChatGPT, prompt templates, or daily prompting WITHOUT ML background: compress block_03 and block_04 to 1-2 nodes total.
learning_1 (learning style) MUST NOT change block selection or order — it may only affect description text (e.g., visual, hands-on).
Total pathway: 10-14 nodes. Include at least one assessment node. block_06 should appear in every pathway (capstone).
